description: Company profile for a domain: the company name and description from its own homepage, social profiles (X, LinkedIn, GitHub and more), public contact emails, domain age and expiry and registrar (RDAP), hosting network and country, mail provider with SPF and DMARC, technology hints (Shopify, WordPress, Next.js...), and whether the domain is on a crypto phishing list. Useful for vendor checks and lead enrichment. Public sources only. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="company_profile".
